name: KG embedding diff sync (hourly reconciler)
notes: [Created 2026-06-12, fragility review #4; hourly cadence is a user directive: 'at least the diff every hour'.] Reconciles the chroma label + identity collections against sqlite: removes ghost vectors (deleted/merged nodes), embeds missing ones (failed inline embeds, new nodes), re-embeds text drift (rename without re-embed). Local MiniLM = free; no-op when in sync. Drift on the resolution path cannot survive an hour. Ghost-cleans the context collection too (its missing/stale handling stays with the context backfill step).
